head.i: Lacedæmon in communionem reipu-blicæ Achaicæ recepta.

main_text.p: SEd vicit sententia Lycortæ, & Lacedæmon in communionem societatis Achaicæ est recepta, atque hoc decretum columnæ, quod fieri in iis, quæ firma & immota censebantur, solebat, inscriptum: & ex exulum numero illi, qui nunquàm ingrati atque improbi in Achæos animi signum edidissent. Mansitque ab eo tempore Lacedæmon consors reipublicæ Achaicæ. His rebus confectis, missus Romam est ab Achæis Bippus Argivus, à Lacedæmoniis Charon, qui de omnibus senatum facerent certiorem. Ab exulibus autem Cletis [illegible, ~3 letters] quoque istuc legatus, qui ipsorum causam contra legatos cæteros tueretur. Qui cum omnes Romæ abundè auditi [illegible, ~3 letters] essent, senatus quidem nihil eorum, quæ à civitate Spartanâ acta erant, reprehendit, aut indignè se ferre ostendit: exulibus vero promisit, ad Achæos se scripturum de illis in patriam restituen[?]-dis. Idem senatus post aliquot dies [illegible, ~3 letters] Bippo cognoscens, cui id in mandatis etiam erat datum, ut eam rem gestam exponeret, [illegible, ~2 letters] Messenen[?] quoque priori lo-co & statui ab Achæis esse restitutam, [illegible, ~3 letters] nec hoc improbavit, legatosque omr[illegible, ~4 letters]

page.notes: The heading is set in italic, with a hyphen at the line end ("reipu-blicæ"). The large initial S of "SEd" is read as S. "Messenen" is uncertain, as are "restituen" and the line end "omr", which runs under a marginal mark. The right-margin marks are very small and mostly unreadable; their positions are approximate. Stray marks at the bottom left ("i ɔc") and bottom right ("ɪɪɪ pd", "ettɪɪɪ pd") are too faint to read reliably and may be signatures, notes or show-through. They are not transcribed.
